note: Clubs that the official ranking lists show for an athlete and that a person reviewed and found to be source errors, with the evidence. scripts/import_rankings.py publishes those rows without a club and records each use in imports/ranking-history/provenance.json (coverage.source_exceptions). A list that was published before the error appeared keeps the club it had then.
